entities.summary: Sassanid Empire, a political institution in Iran during Sassanid Empire (633–651). Grew from Rashidun Caliphate and Khosrow I and Sassanid Zenith. Led to the emergence of Battle of al-Qadisiyyah — Arab forces defeat the Sassanid army and Battle of Nahavand — 'Victory of Victories' ends Sassanid resistance.
